verdict.rationale: The Business & Liens home page states up front that filing goes through a credential account ('Sign In' / 'Create an Account'). The portal docs also explain that one Online Account handles multiple filings and that US Bank payment can be made via 'Pay without Registering', so the account and payment-credential steps are disclosed before starting. Nothing in the evidence documents identity-proofing requirements, or gives an exhaustive pre-flow list of every account and verification step, so the 'exactly' and identity-proofing parts of the story are unevidenced. Missing for 10: an explicit published list of every pre-filing account and identity-proofing step, documentation of whether identity verification is required, and independent or hands-on confirmation that no undisclosed walls appear mid-flow.
